elements.title: Product lifecycle diagram
elements.content: A circular diagram illustrating five stages of the product lifecycle: DESIGN AND SOURCE, MAKE, PACKAGE AND SHIP, USE, RECOVER.

elements.title: iMac recycled content statement
elements.content: iMac contains more than 15 percent recycled content.

elements.title: Recycled materials breakdown
elements.content: Aluminum: We use 100 percent recycled aluminum in the stand. Copper: We use 100 percent recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards. We also use 100 percent recycled copper in multiple thermal module components. Gold: We use 100 percent recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit boards. Plastic: We use at least 50 percent recycled plastic in 13 components. Rare earth elements: We use 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, representing 99 percent of the total rare earth elements in the device. Tin: We use 100 percent recycled tin in the solder of multiple printed circuit boards.
